verdict_reason: Delivery tests skip the new NotificationCreated SNS payload, and the ordering test no longer asserts version order on the queue.

todos.issue: shouldDeliverToSnsAndMarkPublishedAt (and shouldDeliverNotificationEditedToSns) now wait for two SNS messages after NotificationCreated was added as v1, but only inspect the later event; a wrong Created eventType or payload on the wire would still pass.
todos.fix: Assert the aggregateVersion 1 envelope too: eventType NotificationCreated, publishedAt set, and the same identifier/correlation checks used for Submitted/Edited.

todos.issue: shouldPublishAggregateVersionsInOrder no longer asserts delivery order: it sorts Mongo events by version (tautological) and picks SNS messages with snsEnvelopeByAggregateVersion, so any permutation of v1-v3 would pass.
todos.fix: Assert SQS arrival order is aggregateVersion 1, then 2, then 3 (Created, Submitted, Submitted), or extract versions from messages in receive order and assert they equal [1, 2, 3].
